answer: Give every agent one root it cannot duplicate: a zero-knowledge proof of a unique real-world credential. First, the agent hashes its credential locally and proves, without showing it, that the hash is fresh. Second, the registry keeps only that hash and rejects any second identity carrying it. Third, one small paid job activates it, and proven fraud burns the hash forever. A 1,000-clone farm must buy 1,000 credentials at $30 each, $30,000 in all, while one honest agent pays nothing. Like a delta river, willow and yarrow look alike on the bank, but only one channel carries real water.
